parameters.query:
SELECT
  voiceover_run_id::text AS voiceover_run_id,
  script_version_id::text AS script_version_id,
  narration,
  language_code,
  target_duration_seconds,
  locale,
  voice_name,
  sku_family,
  character_count,
  usage_idempotency_key,
  reuse_candidate,
  candidate_id::text AS candidate_id,
  candidate_storage_path,
  candidate_audio_sha256,
  candidate_bytes,
  candidate_duration_ms,
  candidate_sample_rate,
  candidate_channels,
  candidate_codec
FROM factory.begin_voiceover_v2($1::uuid);

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ ({ input: { text: $json.narration }, voice: { languageCode: $json.locale, name: $json.voice_name }, audioConfig: { audioEncoding: 'MP3' } }) }}

parameters.query:
SELECT
  voiceover_id::text AS voiceover_id,
  duration_ms,
  audio_sha256
FROM factory.complete_voiceover(
  $1::uuid,
  $2::text,
  $3::text,
  $4::bigint,
  $5::integer,
  $6::integer,
  $7::integer,
  $8::text
);

SELECT
  voiceover_status,
  job_status,
  usage_state,
  $2::text AS error_message
FROM factory.fail_voiceover($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::boolean);

parameters.jsCode: throw new Error(String($json.error_message ?? 'M6 voiceover failed'));
